newsitem.title: USA: North American Tech sees 96 revs of $5 mln.
newsitem.headline: North American Tech sees 96 revs of $5 mln.

text.p: North American Technologies Group Inc said Monday it expects its 1996 revenues to fall below previous forecasts, and does not anticipate breaking even until during the first half of 1997.
The company said its third quarter revenues did not grow at rates it had expected, coming in at $1.03 million versus $809,047 posted in the same period in the prior year.
As a result, it expects its 1996 revenues to be about $5 million, nearly twice the amount of sales in 1995, but below the $7 million to $10 million it had previously forecast, the company said.

National American Technologies President, Chief Executive and Chairman Tim Tarrillion said in a statement that a capital infusion secured earlier this year has helped the company's financial health to remain sound.
He added that the company's cash reserves should be sufficient to supply its capital requirements until it reaches positive cash-flow operations.
